from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"
    
    event_id = Column(String, primary_key=True)
    title = Column(String)
    description = Column(Text)
    date = Column(String)
    age_limit = Column(Integer)
    prerequisites = Column(String)
    
router = APIRouter()

@router.post("")
def edit_event_details_and_registration(
    event_id: str = Body(..., embed=True),
    details: dict = Body(..., embed=True),
    registration_requirements: dict = Body(..., embed=True)
) -> bool:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Retrieve the event from the database
        event = db.query(Event).filter(Event.event_id == event_id).first()
        
        # Check if event exists
        if not event:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Event not found")
        
        # Update event details
        if "title" in details:
            event.title = details["title"]
        if "description" in details:
            event.description = details["description"]
        if "date" in details:
            event.date = details["date"]
        
        # Update registration requirements
        if "age_limit" in registration_requirements:
            event.age_limit = registration_requirements["age_limit"]
        if "prerequisites" in registration_requirements:
            event.prerequisites = registration_requirements["prerequisites"]
        
        # Commit changes to the database
        db.commit()
        
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        # Rollback in case of error
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        db.close()

from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal

router = APIRouter()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = Column(String, nullable=False)
    is_logged_in = Column(Boolean, default=False)


def prompt_user_to_log_in() -> dict[str, str]:
    """System prompts the user to log in before proceeding with event registration."""
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Check if user is logged in
        user = db.query(User).filter(User.is_logged_in == True).first()
        if user is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Please log in to register for the event.")
        
        # If user is logged in, return success message
        return {"message": "Please log in to register for the event."}
    finally:
        db.close()

import json
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import create_app

client = TestClient(create_app())

def test_edit_event_details_and_registration_anchor_case():
    # Setup is not needed for this test case
    resp = client.post("/controllers/edit_event_details_and_registration", json={"event_id":"evt-123","details":{"title":"Updated Title","description":"New Description"},"registration_requirements":{"age_limit":18}})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == True

def test_edit_event_details_and_registration_empty_details():
    # Setup is not needed for this test case
    resp = client.post("/controllers/edit_event_details_and_registration", json={"event_id":"evt-123","details":{},"registration_requirements":{"age_limit":18}})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == True

def test_edit_event_details_and_registration_missing_registration_requirements():
    # Setup is not needed for this test case
    resp = client.post("/controllers/edit_event_details_and_registration", json={"event_id":"evt-123","details":{"title":"Updated Title","description":"New Description"},"registration_requirements":{}})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == True

def test_edit_event_details_and_registration_non_existent_event():
    # Setup is not needed for this test case
    resp = client.post("/controllers/edit_event_details_and_registration", json={"event_id":"evt-nonexistent","details":{"title":"Updated Title","description":"New Description"},"registration_requirements":{"age_limit":18}})
    assert resp.status_code >= 400
